arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'config' AS kind, service AS id, value AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'booking', b.booking_id, json_object('request',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',charge_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'step',created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) FROM bookings b UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',request_id,json_object('event',event_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'event',event_id,json_object('booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',flight_id,json_object('capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights

SELECT 'config' kind, service id, value data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'event',event_id,json_object('booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'pending',b.booking_id,json_object('request',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',charge_id,'key',idempotency_key,'state',state)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',request_id,json_object('step',step) FROM customer_events

SELECT 'pending' kind,b.booking_id id,json_object('request',b.request_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',charge_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'step',created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) data FROM bookings b WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',b.booking_id,json_object('status',b.status,'refund_cents',(SELECT sum(amount_cents) FROM refunds r WHERE r.booking_id=b.booking_id),'holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id)) FROM customer_events e JOIN bookings b USING(request_id) UNION ALL SELECT 'config',service,value FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',flight_id,json_object('price',price_cents,'version',version,'capacity',capacity,'holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)) FROM flights f UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache
